description: Verify a GYOTAK KOMON record directly from the Midnight blockchain. Reads on-chain state and returns the raw hex plus decoded fields for independent verification. Unlike get_komon_records (which returns GYOTAK's database), this reads directly from the chain. Shielded records do not put the GPS coordinates on the chain, only a hash of them (gpsHash); the region is a label set by GYOTAK. GYOTAK checks the region range when recording, but the range used is not stored in the record, so the region cannot be confirmed from the chain. Currently preprod only.

komonId.description: Filter to a specific komon record by ID. Omit to return all records.

name: verify_komon

availableKomonIds.description: Listed when no record matched komonId

error.description: Same text as content when the input or the lookup failed

message.description: Same text as content when there is nothing to show
